items.title: Electrostatic interactions drive the self-assembly of secondary coat-protein layers around wild-type MS2 particles
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: The protein capsids of many icosahedral RNA viruses can self-assemble in vitro in the absence of any host cell factors. For bacteriophage MS2 and related viruses, previous studies have focused on the role of specific RNA-protein interactions in driving the assembly process. However, the contribution of electrostatics remains unclear. We show that MS2 coat protein dimers can assemble into additional capsid layers around intact wild-type MS2 particles, even in the absence of free RNA. We characterize the size and morphology of the particles through transmission electron microscopy, gel electrophoresis, and dynamic light scattering, and we use binding and infectivity assays to determine how the maturation protein affects layer formation. Our results are consistent with a heterogeneous nucleation-and-growth assembly pathway, in which the nucleation barrier is controlled by the protein concentration, and electrostatic attraction between the positively charged coat proteins and negatively charged capsid drives growth. Interestingly, the secondary layers rarely fully encapsulate the wild-type particles, suggesting that elastic energy may limit their growth. These results highlight the importance of electrostatics in the assembly of protein shells, even in systems such as MS2 that are known for their strong, specific RNA-protein interactions.

items.title: Shedding Light on Quantum Non-Classicality: Witnessing Wigner Negativity with Free Electrons
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: Certifying quantum non-classicality like Wigner negativity typically demands full optical state tomography. This work introduces a noise-resilient framework for witnessing optical Wigner negativity using phase-resolved quantum photon-induced near-field electron microscopy (QPINEM). By mapping electron coherences directly to symmetrically ordered optical characteristic functions within a coupling-limited phase-space region, the protocol bypasses full optical reconstruction. A post-measurement witness matrix is constructed via Bochner's theorem from recorded electron spectra, where negative eigenvalues certify non-classicality. To ensure reliability under realistic experimental conditions, a noise-aware selection procedure decouples discovery from statistical validation. Benchmarked across various optical preparations-including vacuum-Fock superpositions, odd cat states, and GKP states-the protocol provides a statistically bounded pathway for probing quantum features with free electrons.

items.title: Unmyelinated axons alter the biological interpretation of MRI biomarkers of demyelination
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: Quantitative MRI methods are widely used to probe white matter microstructure; yet diffusion- and relaxation-based metrics are often interpreted primarily in terms of myelinated axons, implicitly assuming a negligible contribution from unmyelinated axons. Here, combining diffusion MRI (dMRI), relaxation-based MRI, and electron microscopy (EM) in the cuprizone mouse model of demyelination and recovery, we examine how unmyelinated axons shape MRI-derived microstructural indices, including axonal water fraction and $g$-ratio. To enable quantitative cellular-level comparisons, we developed automated tools for instance-level EM segmentation of white matter, allowing morphological analysis of myelinated and unmyelinated axonal populations. We find that, in the mouse model, diffusion-derived estimates of axonal water fraction reflect contributions from both axonal populations at sufficiently short diffusion times; accounting for unmyelinated axons removes an apparent bias and reveals that this metric corresponds to the total intra-axonal space rather than myelinated fibers alone. Similarly, MRI-derived $g$-ratio estimates correlate strongly with EM only when both axonal populations are included. We further demonstrate that within-voxel $g$-ratio heterogeneity introduces a systematic negative bias of up to $8\%$, increasing with the fraction of unmyelinated axons and variability in myelin thickness. Together, these findings change the biological interpretation of MRI biomarkers during demyelination by demonstrating that unmyelinated axons are a major determinant of MRI-derived white matter indices and that combining diffusion and relaxation contrasts enables a more accurate and interpretable quantification of demyelination. They further highlight the need for quantitative biomarkers that account for axonal heterogeneity in both health and disease.

items.title: Micrograph B-factor estimation via Wilson statistics
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: The single-particle cryo-electron microscopy imaging process is known to cause exponential decay in the amplitude and power spectra of proteins. This decay is modeled by the B factor and is currently corrected as a post-processing stage of the 3D reconstruction. As a consequence, all experimental images in the dataset are assumed to share the same B factor. In this paper, we suggest a novel approach wherein the B factor is determined and corrected as a preprocessing step to the reconstruction. We show such an approach can improve reconstruction resolution.

items.title: quantEM: Quantitative Electron Microscopy Analysis from Differentiable Physics to Neural Priors
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: Quantitative electron microscopy includes imaging, diffraction, spectroscopy, and tomography measurements, and the analysis of these measurements increasingly requires solving inverse problems with physical forward models. Open-source software has made many of these analyses widely available, but most packages are organized around a single modality, so that multimodal analyses require moving data between packages, and new methods cannot easily reuse the physical models and optimizers of existing ones. Here we present quantEM, an open-source Python package for quantitative electron microscopy that uses PyTorch tensors for computation and automatic differentiation, and Zarr for storage. We implement each analysis method by writing a differentiable forward model and choosing a representation, loss function, constraints, and optimizer from a library of components, so that every method runs on CPUs and GPUs, can be saved and resumed, and uses the same calibrated data structures and visualization tools. We describe the current modules, including orientation and strain mapping, direct and iterative ptychography, tomography with neural representations, and X-ray and electron energy-loss spectroscopy, and show how we assemble combined methods such as ptychographic tomography from existing components. quantEM is available under the MIT license, together with documentation, tutorials, and curated example datasets.

fact_card.core_claim: quantEM 是一个开源 Python 包，利用 PyTorch 张量和自动微分实现定量电子显微镜分析，通过可微分物理前向模型和组件库支持多模态分析。
key_facts: 定量电子显微镜包括成像、衍射、光谱和断层扫描测量，其分析日益需要利用物理前向模型求解逆问题。
现有开源软件大多围绕单一模态组织，导致多模态分析需要在不同软件包之间移动数据，且新方法难以复用现有的物理模型和优化器。
quantEM 使用 PyTorch 张量进行计算和自动微分，并使用 Zarr 进行存储。
每个分析方法通过编写可微分前向模型，并从组件库中选择表示、损失函数、约束和优化器来实现。
所有方法均可在 CPU 和 GPU 上运行，支持保存和恢复，并使用相同的校准数据结构和可视化工具。
当前模块包括取向和应变映射、直接和迭代ptychography（叠层成像）、具有神经表示的断层扫描，以及 X 射线和电子能量损失光谱。

items.title: High-resolution top-down nanopatterning of NbN thin films for superconducting metamaterials
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: Periodic nanopatterning offers a route to tailoring vortex motion and the electromagnetic response of superconducting films, providing a basis for superconducting metamaterials. Here, we report a high-resolution top-down nanopatterning process for ultrathin epitaxial NbN films on sapphire substrates. Electron-beam lithography using hydrogen silsesquioxane (HSQ) and ZEP 530A resists was optimized through proximity-effect correction and adhesion-layer integration. Dense superconducting nanowire grids with pitches down to 70 nm were fabricated, alongside millimeter-square areas patterned with 100-nm-pitch hole arrays with high pattern fidelity. A thin Si capping layer was found to significantly improve HSQ adhesion on epitaxial NbN. The nanopatterns were successfully transferred into 5-nm-thick NbN films by reactive ion etching (RIE). Structural and dimensional characterization was performed using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), and atomic force microscopy (AFM), enabling cross-validation of nanoscale feature dimensions and etch quality. Electrical transport measurements reveal periodic resistance minima and switching-current oscillations at magnetic fields set by the hole-array pitch, consistent with enhanced vortex pinning when the vortex configuration matches the patterned lattice. Cryogenic THz time-domain spectroscopy further reveals a reduced superfluid density in the nanopatterned region relative to pristine NbN, while both regions have a spectroscopic superconducting transition near 14 K. These results establish a robust fabrication platform for superconducting nanopatterns targeting vortex pinning, metamaterials, and quantum-device applications.

fact_card.core_claim: 报告了一种用于蓝宝石衬底上超薄外延NbN薄膜的高分辨率自上而下纳米图案化工艺，成功制备了70 nm间距的超导纳米线网格和100 nm间距的孔阵列，并验证了其在涡旋钉扎和超导特性调控中的应用潜力。
key_facts: 使用氢硅氧烷（HSQ）和ZEP 530A抗蚀剂，通过邻近效应校正和粘附层集成优化了电子束光刻工艺。
发现薄Si覆盖层能显著改善HSQ在外延NbN上的粘附性。
通过反应离子刻蚀（RIE）将纳米图案成功转移到5 nm厚的NbN薄膜中。
利用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、透射电子显微镜（TEM）和原子力显微镜（AFM）对结构、尺寸及刻蚀质量进行了表征和交叉验证。
电输运测量显示，在由孔阵列间距决定的磁场下出现周期性电阻极小值和开关电流振荡，这与涡旋构型匹配图案化晶格时增强的涡旋钉扎一致。

items.title: Engineering antiferromagnetic (LaVO3)m/(PrVO3)n superlattices
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: In this study, we demonstrate the atomic-scale engineering of antiferromagnetic (LaVO3)m/(PrVO3)n superlattices grown by MBE on (001)-oriented SrTiO3 substrates. Our work achieved a precise layer-by-layer control, revealing how interface-driven structural distortions can be systematically tuned. X-ray diffraction and reciprocal space mapping confirm both the epitaxial strain state and the high crystalline quality of the superlattices. High-resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy further uncovers layer-resolved atomic displacements, where La3+ and Pr3+ exhibit antipolar motions modulated by the superlattice periodicity. The alternate stackings of LaVO3 and PrVO3 yield a unique antiferromagnetic transition temperature, which can be tuned by adjusting their relative proportions. This behavior exists despite the distinct spin ordering temperatures observed in the constituent materials. Layer-resolved spectroscopic measurements reveal that the hybridization of La and Pr 5d orbitals with O 2p orbitals is also modulated and directly correlated to the oxygen octahedra rotations. By determining the orbital hybridization and mapping the cation displacements as proxies, we can visualize indirectly the trilinear coupling between oxygen octahedra rotations and antipolar rare earth displacements. Notably, the interfacial oxygen octahedra connectivity between cubic SrTiO3 substrate and orthorhombic vanadate layers significantly influences the structural distortions. These distortions, almost quenched near the interface, relax over few unit cells, demonstrating how strain and interfacial effects propagate through the superlattice. This study illustrates how artificial superlattices can be engineered to control structural distortions at the atomic scale, offering a pathway to tune the magnetic properties through strain-distortion relationships in perovskite oxides.

fact_card.core_claim: 通过分子束外延（MBE）在SrTiO3衬底上制备了原子尺度可控的反铁磁(LaVO3)m/(PrVO3)n超晶格，揭示了界面驱动的结构畸变及其对磁性和轨道杂化的调控机制。
key_facts: 利用MBE技术在(001)-取向的SrTiO3衬底上生长了反铁磁(LaVO3)m/(PrVO3)n超晶格，实现了逐层精确控制。
X射线衍射和倒易空间映射证实了超晶格的 epitaxial strain state（外延应变状态）和高结晶质量。
高分辨扫描透射电子显微镜揭示了层分辨的原子位移，其中La3+和Pr3+表现出受超晶格周期性调制的反极性运动（antipolar motions）。
LaVO3和PrVO3的交替堆叠产生独特的反铁磁转变温度，可通过调整两者的相对比例进行调节，尽管组分材料具有不同的自旋有序温度。
层分辨光谱测量显示，La和Pr的5d轨道与O的2p轨道的杂化受到调制，并与氧八面体旋转直接相关。
立方SrTiO3衬底与正交晶系钒酸盐层之间的界面氧八面体连接性显著影响结构畸变，这些畸变在界面附近几乎被抑制，并在几个晶胞内弛豫。

items.title: Zernike-efficient phase contrast with a scanned electron probe

items.summary: For weak-phase objects, scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) with a far-field detector transfers at most half of the phase information per electron that Zernike phase-contrast (ZPC) conventional transmission electron microscopy (CTEM) achieves. We propose APEX (Apex Phase-plate EXit-wave imaging), a scanned-probe mode that combines a defocused probe, a $π/2$ phase element in a magnified image of the probe crossover, and in-focus image-plane detection at each scan position. It applies the generalized Zernike framework of Dwyer and Paganin to a scanned probe. In a linear model of a thin weak-phase object with an ideal phase dot, APEX transfers nearly the full Zernike Fisher information over a wide band, substantially more than diffraction-plane four-dimensional STEM (4D-STEM). In idealized simulations of myoglobin in vitreous ice at a cryo-EM dose (elastic scattering only, no chromatic aberration, full coherence), ideal-dot APEX at a probe defocus of 1 $μ$m reconstructs the phase more accurately than defocused 4D-STEM ptychography with one untuned probe setting. At a defocus of about 25 $μ$m, a crossed laser phase plate (XLPP) acts as the $π/2$ element, and APEX of a periodic specimen cell comes close to CTEM with the same plate. In two dimensions, this mode is equivalent to laser phase-plate CTEM of a small, scanned area. A single simulated APEX scan with the XLPP also separates two myoglobin phase screens 150 nm apart in vacuum, at known depths, which is not possible with one ZPC CTEM exposure.

items.title: Swift Heavy Ion Tracks in Polymorphs of Titanium Dioxide: The Effects of Electron Beam and Crystal Structures
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: Swift heavy ion (SHI) irradiation generates nanoscale damage in materials, offering opportunities for controlled modification of structural properties. Understanding the fundamental processes governing damage formation in altered regions remains a longstanding challenge. This work explores how crystal structure influences swift heavy ion-induced damage formation and evolution in rutile and anatase TiO2. Combining transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and molecular dynamics simulations, we investigate how differences in atomic arrangement govern track morphology and structural recovery. Although irradiation produces amorphous tracks in both polymorphs, their morphologies differ considerably. In rutile, tracks develop pronounced diameter variations, forming hourglass-like structures, whereas in anatase they retain a relatively uniform cylindrical shape. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal that these differences arise from the distinct recrystallization behavior of the two crystal structures during rapid cooling, leading to different pathways of track evolution and recovery. Particular attention is paid to electron beam induced effects during TEM characterization, which can substantially modify the structure and apparent morphology of ion tracks. Prolonged electron beam exposure promotes the recrystallization of initially amorphous tracks and surface hillocks, accompanied by the development of Fresnel contrast. These findings highlight the importance of understanding beam-induced transformations for the reliable interpretation of TEM observations of radiation-damaged materials.

fact_card.core_claim: 本文通过透射电子显微镜（TEM）和分子动力学模拟，揭示了金红石型和锐钛矿型二氧化钛中快重离子（SHI）辐照损伤形态差异源于两者在快速冷却过程中不同的再结晶行为，并强调了电子束诱导效应对TEM观测结果解释的重要性。
key_facts: 快重离子（SHI）辐照在材料中产生纳米尺度损伤，为结构特性的可控改性提供了机会。
研究结合透射电子显微镜（TEM）和分子动力学模拟，探讨原子排列差异如何控制径迹（track）形态和结构恢复。
虽然两种多晶型（金红石型和锐钛矿型）二氧化钛辐照后均产生非晶径迹，但其形态差异显著。
金红石型（rutile）中的径迹表现出明显的直径变化，形成沙漏状结构；而锐钛矿型（anatase）中的径迹保持相对均匀的圆柱形。
分子动力学模拟显示，这些差异源于两种晶体结构在快速冷却期间不同的再结晶行为，导致径迹演化和恢复路径不同。
长时间电子束照射会促进初始非晶径迹和表面鼓包（hillocks）的再结晶，并伴随菲涅耳衬度（Fresnel contrast）的发展。

第一条来自 arXiv 预印本，这是一篇未经同行评审的论文。作者 Colin Ophus 等人开发了一个名为 quantEM 的开源 Python 包。这个工具利用 PyTorch 张量和自动微分技术，实现了定量电子显微镜分析。它通过可微分物理前向模型和组件库，支持多模态分析。目前该模块包括取向和应变映射、直接和迭代叠层成像、具有神经表示的断层扫描，以及 X 射线和电子能量损失光谱。所有方法均可在 CPU 和 GPU 上运行，并使用相同的校准数据结构和可视化工具。

另一条来自 arXiv 预印本，同样未经同行评审。作者 Francesca Incalza 等人报告了一种用于蓝宝石衬底上超薄外延氮化铌薄膜的高分辨率自上而下纳米图案化工艺。他们成功制备了 70 nm 间距的超导纳米线网格和 100 nm 间距的孔阵列。实验使用了 5 nm 厚的氮化铌薄膜，并通过反应离子刻蚀将纳米图案转移。电输运测量显示，在由孔阵列间距决定的磁场下出现周期性电阻极小值。低温太赫兹时域光谱显示，纳米图案化区域的超流密度降低，但光谱超导转变温度均在 14 K 附近。

另一条来自 arXiv 预印本，未经同行评审。作者 A. Benedit-Cardenas 等人通过分子束外延技术在 (001)-取向的 SrTiO3 衬底上制备了原子尺度可控的反铁磁 (LaVO3)m/(PrVO3)n 超晶格。高分辨扫描透射电子显微镜揭示了层分辨的原子位移，其中 La3+ 和 Pr3+ 表现出受超晶格周期性调制的反极性运动。层分辨光谱测量显示，La 和 Pr 的 5d 轨道与 O 的 2p 轨道的杂化受到调制，并与氧八面体旋转直接相关。这些结构畸变在界面附近几乎被抑制，并在几个晶胞内弛豫。

另一条来自 arXiv 预印本，未经同行评审。作者 Philipp Pelz 提出了一种名为 APEX 的扫描探针成像模式。该模式结合离焦探针、π/2 相位元件和像平面检测。在弱相位物体成像中，APEX 比四维 STEM 传输更多的 Zernike Fisher 信息。在肌红蛋白在玻璃态冰中的理想化模拟中，探针离焦 1 μm 时的理想点 APEX 比使用一个未调谐探针设置的离焦四维 STEM 叠层成像更准确地重建相位。在约 25 μm 的离焦下，交叉激光相位板作为 π/2 元件，周期性样品单元的 APEX 成像接近于使用相同相位板的常规透射电子显微镜。单次使用交叉激光相位板的模拟 APEX 扫描可以在真空中分离相距 150 nm 的两个肌红蛋白相位屏。需要注意的是，这些结论基于仅包含弹性散射、无色差且完全相干的模拟假设。

另一条来自 arXiv 预印本，未经同行评审。作者 Xiaoting Jia 等人通过透射电子显微镜和分子动力学模拟，研究了金红石型和锐钛矿型二氧化钛中快重离子辐照损伤形态的差异。研究发现，金红石型中的径迹表现出明显的直径变化，形成沙漏状结构；而锐钛矿型中的径迹保持相对均匀的圆柱形。分子动力学模拟显示，这些差异源于两种晶体结构在快速冷却期间不同的再结晶行为。此外，长时间电子束照射会促进初始非晶径迹和表面鼓包的再结晶，并伴随菲涅耳衬度的发展。

items.title: DT-MATCH: Defect- and Topology-Aware Chiplet Matching for Yield Optimization in Heterogeneous Integration

fact_card.core_claim: 提出了一种名为 DT-MATCH 的缺陷与拓扑感知芯片小片（chiplet）匹配框架，旨在现实组装约束下最大化功能 SoC 的数量。
key_facts: 异构集成（heterogeneous integration）和先进封装引入了由制造缺陷和复杂的 die-to-die (D2D) 互连约束导致的新良率挑战。
DT-MATCH 提供了两种互补的方法：基于整数线性规划（integer linear programming, ILP）的方法和基于贪心随机自适应搜索过程（greedy randomized adaptive search procedure, GRASP）的方法。
基于 ILP 的方法使用批处理策略（batching strategy）来近似精确公式。
基于 GRASP 的方法提供显著加速，但不保证良率最优性。
两种方法都使用预处理流水线（preprocessing pipeline）来减小问题规模。
在工业设计上的实验结果表明，基于 ILP 的方法实现了更优的解质量，而基于 GRASP 的方法运行时间更低且解质量与基于 ILP 的解相当。

caveats: 基于 GRASP 的方法不保证良率最优性（does not guarantee yield optimality）。

再看一篇 arXiv 预印本论文，作者是 Michael Deimetry。该研究探讨了如何从动量分辨的核心损失 4D-STEM 数据中确定掺杂剂的三维深度分布。在 Born 近似下，通过对数据集沿探针位置进行傅里叶变换，可以揭示出条纹，其频率编码了掺杂剂距离焦平面的距离。虽然动态散射会降低条纹对比度，但可以通过在非主要晶带轴采集数据部分恢复。为了缓解核心损失散射通常伴随的过高剂量问题，研究引入了贝叶斯框架。在模拟的掺杂铁钛酸锶样品上，该方法实现了纳米到亚纳米的深度精度，且深度精度在 100 到 1000 个核心损失计数范围内有效。需要强调的是，这一精度验证是基于模拟数据，而非实验测量，且方法依赖于 Born 近似。

最后一条来自 arXiv 的预印本论文，作者 Charles G. Woychik 等人。这篇技术综述讨论了超细间距混合键合面临的挑战。混合键合是支持芯粒、逻辑、内存和专用加速器异构集成的基础技术，行业正推动互连间距接近个位数微米及以下。主要技术挑战包括实现极紧的晶圆和芯片对准公差、在纳米尺度保持表面平整度和清洁度、控制化学机械抛光过程中的铜凹陷和介质侵蚀，以及确保无缺陷的氧化物和铜-铜键合界面。此外，扩展到超细间距还需要在计量、缺陷检测、热管理和良率控制方面进行改进，以支持高产量制造。与硅中介层、晶圆对晶圆以及芯片对晶圆键合架构的集成进一步增加了工艺复杂性。

items.title: SPLIT-MOR: Fast and Accurate Model Order Reduction for Nonlinear Transient Thermal Simulation of 2.5D/3D ICs
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: Fast and accurate transient thermal simulation is essential to thermal reliability analysis and dynamic thermal management of advanced packages, and model order reduction (MOR) techniques are widely applied to overcome the efficiency bottleneck of rigorous numerical methods. However, nonlinear terms including temperature-dependent leakage power, thermal conductivity, and heat capacity prevent the application of conventional linear MOR, while hyper-reduction solutions require costly nonlinear training data. In this work, we propose SPLIT-MOR (Subdomain-wise Piecewise Linearization with Interval Tensors), a novel nonlinear MOR method that requires no additional training set. SPLIT-MOR computes reduced component tensors by subdomain clustering and temperature-interval partitioning in the offline stage, and updates the reduced coefficient matrices and load vectors efficiently in the online stage. Experimental results show that the online solving time of SPLIT-MOR achieves up to an 830x speedup over COMSOL and a 7.5x speedup over the state-of-the-art hyper-reduction method MDEIM, with a 27x total reduction in the offline time. The relative average error remains below 0.11%, and the maximum error is below 0.86 degrees Celsius, demonstrating the high accuracy of our method.

大家好，这里是《X射线无损检测与AI图像处理前沿》。

首先来看一条来自 DIGITIMES 的消息。DIGITIMES 发表了一篇文章，题目是《先進封裝將熱與接觸難題提前至晶圓測試 AI效益將先集中於測試判定與停機管理》。全文暂未获取，细节这里不展开。

另一条来自 arXiv 的预印本论文，需要说明的是，预印本还没有经过同行评审。这篇论文由 Zebin Shi 等人撰写，研究的是针对 2.5D 和 3D IC 快速瞬态热仿真的非线性模型降阶方法。

在先进封装中，由于存在温度相关的漏电流、热导率和热容等非线性项，传统的线性模型降阶技术无法直接应用。而现有的超约化解决方案虽然能处理非线性，但需要昂贵的非线性训练数据。为了解决这个问题，作者提出了一种名为 SPLIT-MOR 的方法，即子域分段线性化与区间张量。

SPLIT-MOR 的工作流程分为离线和在线两个阶段。在离线阶段，该方法通过子域聚类和温度区间划分来计算缩减分量张量。在在线阶段，它高效地更新缩减系数矩阵和负载向量。这种设计使得该方法无需额外的训练集，就能实现快速求解。

论文在数值实验中验证了该方法的效果。结果显示，SPLIT-MOR 的平均相对误差低于 0.11%，最大误差低于 0.86 摄氏度。在速度方面，在线求解时间相比 COMSOL 实现了高达 830 倍的加速，相比最先进超约化方法 MDEIM 实现了 7.5 倍的加速。此外，离线时间总体减少了 27 倍。

我个人的理解是，对于从事热仿真或封装设计的工程师来说，这种无需训练数据且能大幅加速的方法，可能在迭代设计阶段很有价值。不过，论文目前仅在数值实验层面进行了验证，实际工程应用中的表现还需进一步观察。

我们下期见。

items.title: Nondestructive 3D Metrology of Through-Glass Via Geometry and Internal Wall Texture Using Holotomography
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: Through-glass vias (TGVs) are increasingly important for semiconductor packaging, yet their internal geometry and wall texture remain difficult to characterize nondestructively. Here, we use holotomography (HT) to inspect the three-dimensional (3D) geometry and internal wall texture of intact, unfilled TGVs before metallization. HT reconstructs the refractive index (RI) distribution of the glass and via. Maps of RI and spatially filtered RI then localize the internal boundary. Geometric fitting quantifies via dimensions and taper, while spatial filtering separates slowly varying wall form from finer texture. The reconstructed surface supports volumetric visualization, dimensional measurements and spatial characterization of wall texture within one optical inspection workflow. These measurements reveal internal features inaccessible from surface views and provide quantitative descriptors to evaluate TGVs

items.title: Lithium redistribution and electrode degradation in commercial NMC/Graphite and LCO/Graphite cells under high-rate cycling conditions
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: Fast charging accelerates degradation in lithium-ion batteries, but the effects of cathode chemistry and charging protocol remain difficult to separate. Here, commercial NMC811/graphite (200 mAh) and LCO/graphite (45 mAh) coin cells were cycled for 100 cycles at 0.3C, 1C, 2C, and 3C, followed by scanning electron microscopy (SEM), X-ray diffraction (XRD), and nuclear reaction analysis (NRA). Both cell types exhibited a transition in cycling stability between 1C and 2C. NMC811/graphite retained approximately 99.7% of its initial discharge capacity at 0.3C and 1C, decreasing to 72.3% at 2C and 63.5% at 3C, while LCO/graphite retained only 11.1% at 2C. NRA revealed maximum lithium accumulation in graphite anodes at 2C for both chemistries, supported by SEM observations of granular surface deposits. XRD showed rate-dependent shifts in cathode (003) and graphite (002) reflections, indicating structural changes during cycling. The lower lithium accumulation at 3C was associated with reduced charge throughput, while the LCO/graphite 3C condition was limited by its charging protocol. These findings highlight the importance of anode-side degradation and charging protocols in interpreting high-rate cycling performance of commercial lithium-ion batteries.

items.title: Nanostructuring Semiconductor Surfaces Using Self-Assembled Metal Nanoparticles for Optoelectronic Applications
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: Semiconductor nanostructures are key light-management elements because their geometry can strengthen light-matter interaction, suppress reflection, and enhance optical coupling. Yet their adoption across material platforms is constrained by lithography, multistep pattern transfer, persistent masks, and material-specific etching. Here, we introduce a lithography-free two-step strategy in which thermally evaporated self-assembled Ga nanoparticles act as self-consuming masks during Ar inductively coupled plasma reactive-ion etching. Correlated transmission electron microscopy on GaAs reveals the formation mechanism. Comparable erosion of the Ga nanoparticles and exposed substrate progressively converts Ga-capped pedestals into pure semiconductor nanocones while preserving crystalline order. Nanocone dimensions extend from tens to hundreds of nanometres, and surface coverage is tunable through Ga deposition and plasma power. The same process produces nanocones on GaP and Si and dense nanostructures on polycrystalline hybrid metal-halide perovskite without detectable PbI2 formation. During nanostructuring, the sun-weighted reflectance reaches minima of 11-15% on the monocrystalline substrates, whereas the perovskite achieves 0.5% after complete mask consumption. The approach therefore combines a self-assembled mask, its consumption, and pattern transfer in a single physical etching step, providing a simple route to light-coupling surfaces for III-V, Si, and perovskite optoelectronics.

items.title: Statistical Analysis of the Structure from Noise Phenomenon in Generalized Procrustes Problems
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: In cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM), observations are highly noisy, and scientists often use reference templates to guide matching, alignment, and averaging to reconstruct the molecular structure. However, these procedures can produce an output resembling the template even when the observations contain only noise, a phenomenon known as Einstein from noise (EfN). This phenomenon has attracted attention in statistics, where simplified observation models involving group actions have been studied to understand the resulting model bias. Characterizing the bias in the full cryo-EM pipeline remains challenging. We study template matching and averaging in the generalized orthogonal Procrustes problem, which provides an analytically tractable setting involving continuous orthogonal group action and lower-dimensional projections of ordered point clouds. We show that, for pure Gaussian noise, the mean of the aligned-and-averaged estimator admits the same left and right singular-vector bases as the template but its singular values may be distorted. This identifies the subspace structure imposed by the template even in the absence of signal. We characterize the singular values and bound their distortion, establish finite-sample operator-norm bounds, and give sufficient sample sizes for the population mean to dominate random fluctuations. In fact, this bias still exists under weak signals: when the template rank is at least the observation dimension, the change from the pure-noise mean is $O(η^2)$ in signal amplitude $η$. Our results provide an explicit characterization of model bias in a registration problem motivated by cryo-EM and show why averaging more observations can stabilize structure imposed by the template without removing the bias.

fact_card.core_claim: 在广义正交 Procrustes 问题中，即使观测仅包含纯高斯噪声，模板匹配和平均后的估计量均值仍会保留模板的奇异向量基，且这种偏差在弱信号下依然存在。

研究聚焦于广义正交 Procrustes 问题，该设置涉及连续正交群作用以及有序点云的降维投影。
对于纯高斯噪声，对齐并平均后的估计量的均值具有与模板相同的左和右奇异向量基，但其奇异值可能会失真。

增加观测数量可以稳定由模板施加的结构，但无法消除偏差。

items.title: Bezier-GP: Bezier-Surface-Based Gaussian Process for Chips-on-Wafer Warpage Modeling
items.source_name: arXiv: TSV / 封装 / 无损检测 / 显微
items.summary: As the semiconductor industry transitions to the post-Moore paradigm, wafer warpage has become a critical quality issue in advanced packaging; particularly for 3D stacking and high-bandwidth memory manufacturing where die-level deformation can affect bonding quality, interconnect reliability, and yield. However, direct high-throughput measurement of individual chip warpage remains difficult in mass-production environments, while existing wafer-level metrology systems routinely provide dense 3D shape data at the wafer scale. This paper proposes a Bezier-surface-based Gaussian Process---known as Bezier-GP---for chips-on-wafer warpage modeling. The proposed framework combines wafer-level point-cloud metrology data with wafer-map layout information to construct chip-region-level Bezier surface patches, imposes continuity constraints between neighboring patches, and represents the resulting chips-on-wafer surface through a compact free-control-point vector. A GP is then introduced in this low-dimensional representation to model wafer-to-wafer variation, chip-region-level spatial dependence, and provide uncertainty quantification. Numerical experiments, using an ASC wafer-map layout, demonstrate that the proposed framework can reconstruct chips-on-wafer surfaces, preserve chip-region-level geometric interpretability, and recover population-level mean and covariance structures under a controlled multi-wafer simulation setting. The results suggest that Bezier-GP provides a measurement-driven statistical modeling foundation for connecting wafer-level metrology data to chip-region-level warpage analysis in semiconductor manufacturing.

fact_card.core_claim: 提出了一种基于贝塞尔曲面（Bezier-surface-based）的高斯过程（Gaussian Process）模型 Bezier-GP，用于结合晶圆级点云测量数据和晶圆图布局信息，对晶圆上芯片（chips-on-wafer）的翘曲进行建模、重构及不确定性量化。
key_facts: 该框架结合晶圆级点云测量数据（wafer-level point-cloud metrology data）与晶圆图布局信息（wafer-map layout information）构建芯片区域级的贝塞尔曲面片（chip-region-level Bezier surface patches）。
模型在相邻曲面片之间施加连续性约束（continuity constraints），并通过紧凑的自由控制点向量（compact free-control-point vector）表示晶圆上芯片的表面。

首先来看 arXiv 上一篇预印本论文，需要说明的是，预印本还没有经过同行评审。这篇由 Dohyeon Lee 等人发表的文章，研究利用全息断层扫描技术，在金属化前对完整未填充的玻璃通孔进行无损三维几何形状和内部壁面纹理表征。据论文描述，玻璃通孔在半导体封装中日益重要，但其内部几何形状和壁面纹理难以无损表征。该研究使用全息断层扫描检查完整、未填充且未金属化的玻璃通孔，重建玻璃和通孔的折射率分布，通过折射率图和空间滤波折射率图定位内部边界。几何拟合用于量化通孔尺寸和锥度，空间滤波将缓慢变化的壁面形状与更精细的纹理分离。这些测量揭示了从表面视角无法访问的内部特征，并提供评估玻璃通孔的定量描述符。

另一条来自 arXiv 的预印本论文，由 Naisargi Kanabar 等人发表，研究商用镍钴锰酸锂和钴酸锂纽扣电池在高倍率循环下的锂再分布和电极退化。据论文数据，商用镍钴锰酸锂电池容量为 200 mAh，钴酸锂电池容量为 45 mAh，两者均在 0.3C、1C、2C 和 3C 下循环 100 次。结果显示，两种电池类型在 1C 和 2C 之间均表现出循环稳定性的转变。具体而言，镍钴锰酸锂在 0.3C 和 1C 下保留了约 99.7% 的初始放电容量，在 2C 下保留 72.3% 容量，在 3C 下保留 63.5% 容量。而钴酸锂在 2C 下仅保留了 11.1% 的容量。核反应分析显示两种化学体系在 2C 时石墨负极锂积累最大，扫描电子显微镜观察到颗粒状表面沉积物支持这一发现。X射线衍射显示正极和石墨反射峰随倍率发生偏移，表明循环过程中发生结构变化。文章指出，钴酸锂在 3C 条件下的表现受其充电协议限制。

接下来是 S. Catalán-Gomez 等人发表在 arXiv 的预印本论文，提出一种无光刻的两步策略，利用热蒸发自组装的镓纳米颗粒作为自消耗掩模，在氩气感应耦合等离子体反应离子刻蚀中制备半导体纳米锥。据论文描述，该方法适用于 III-V 族、硅和钙钛矿材料。透射电子显微镜揭示了砷化镓上的形成机制，镓纳米颗粒和暴露基底的相似侵蚀将镓帽基座逐渐转化为纯半导体纳米锥，同时保持晶体有序性。该过程在磷化镓、硅以及多晶混合金属卤化物钙钛矿上均能产生纳米锥或致密纳米结构。论文指出，纳米锥尺寸从几十到几百纳米，单晶基底上的太阳加权反射率最低达到 11% 到 15%，钙钛矿在掩模完全消耗后太阳加权反射率达到 0.5%。在钙钛矿上未检测到碘化铅的形成。

另一条来自 arXiv 的预印本论文，由 Jiayang Yin 等人发表，研究广义正交 Procrustes 问题中的“从噪声中产生爱因斯坦”现象。据论文分析，在冷冻电子显微镜中，使用参考模板引导匹配、对齐和平均可能会产生类似模板的输出，即使观测仅包含噪声。研究聚焦于涉及连续正交群作用以及有序点云降维投影的广义正交 Procrustes 问题。对于纯高斯噪声，对齐并平均后的估计量的均值具有与模板相同的左和右奇异向量基，但其奇异值可能会失真。当模板秩至少等于观测维度时，从纯噪声均值的变化量与信号幅度的平方同阶。增加观测数量可以稳定由模板施加的结构，但无法消除偏差。文章指出，结论主要基于纯高斯噪声假设以及弱信号条件下的分析。

潮起网发表了一篇文章，题目是《先进封装扩产潮，还差哪些？》。全文暂未获取，细节这里不展开。

最后一条来自 arXiv 的预印本论文，由 Sangyup Lee 等人发表，提出了一种基于贝塞尔曲面的高斯过程模型 Bezier-GP，用于结合晶圆级点云测量数据和晶圆图布局信息，对晶圆上芯片的翘曲进行建模、重构及不确定性量化。据论文描述，该框架结合晶圆级点云测量数据与晶圆图布局信息构建芯片区域级的贝塞尔曲面片。模型在相邻曲面片之间施加连续性约束，并通过紧凑的自由控制点向量表示晶圆上芯片的表面。引入高斯过程以建模晶圆间变异、芯片区域级空间依赖性并提供不确定性量化。数值实验使用 ASC 晶圆图布局，在受控的多晶圆仿真设置下验证了模型性能。实验结果表明该框架能够重构晶圆上芯片表面，保持芯片区域级的几何可解释性，并恢复总体水平的均值和协方差结构。文章指出，验证基于受控的多晶圆仿真设置，而非实际量产环境中的直接测量。

items.title: 先进封装概念股有哪些?台美股先进封装投资一览| EBC金融集团
items.source_name: Google News RSS: TSV / 封装 / 检测 (中文)

fact_card.core_claim: 先进封装已成为半导体产业新的投资热点，其技术涵盖CoWoS、SoIC等，产业链延伸至晶圆代工、设备、检测、材料及载板等多个领域，美股和台股均有代表性上市公司。
key_facts: 先进封装（Advanced Packaging）通过更精密的芯片互连、堆叠及整合技术，将多个芯片或不同功能的半导体元件组合在同一封装结构中，以提升整体性能、降低功耗并改善空间利用效率。
目前市场关注的先进封装技术主要包括：CoWoS（台积电推出的2.5D封装技术）、SoIC（3D芯片堆叠技术）、Chiplet（将大型芯片拆分成多个功能模块）、Fan-Out（扇出型封装技术）及HBM（高带宽内存）。
先进封装成为市场焦点的原因包括：AI芯片需求持续增长带动CoWoS及相关封装产能需求；先进制程微缩难度提高促使通过Chiplet及先进封装整合不同芯片；产业链受惠范围扩大至封装设备、检测设备、材料、载板及专业封测厂商。
美股先进封装相关企业主要集中在半导体设备、晶圆制造、芯片设计、材料及封装测试等领域，代表企业包括台积电(TSM)、应用材料(AMAT)、科林研发(LRCX)、科磊(KLAC)、艾克尔(AMKR)及英特尔(INTC)。
台股拥有完整的半导体产业链，先进封装概念股分为晶圆制造与IC设计、封装测试、半导体设备、检测及材料等类别，代表企业包括台积电(2330)、日月光投控(3711)、弘塑(3131)、辛耘(3583)、均华(6640)、万润(6187)、颖崴(6515)、旺矽(6223)、京元电子(2449)及欣兴(3037)。
面板级封装（FOPLP）利用较大面积的面板作为加工平台，有机会提高生产面积利用率并降低部分封装成本，但其量产能力、良率及客户导入进度仍是未来发展的关键。
fact_card.maturity: 不适用
caveats: 面板级封装（FOPLP）的量产能力、良率及客户导入进度仍是未来发展的关键。
对于投资者而言，观察先进封装概念股时，不应只关注市场题材热度，更需要了解企业在产业链中的实际位置、订单成长、客户认证及营收贡献。

大家好，这里是《X射线无损检测与AI图像处理前沿》。

首先来看混合键合空洞检测设备市场。据财富号报道，根据 QYResearch 统计预测，2025 年全球混合键合空洞检测设备市场规模为 3.21 亿美元，预计 2032 年将增长至 6.14 亿美元，2026 到 2032 年的复合增速为 9.8%。2025 年全球出货量为 517 台，单台均价约 62 万美元。行业主流技术路线分为声学、红外和激光声学三大方向，其中激光声学目前还处在量产验证阶段。市场按最小可检出空洞直径划分档位，包括大于等于 3 微米、1 微米到 3 微米、0.5 微米到 1 微米，以及小于 0.5 微米。文章指出，纸面指标不等于现场能力，最终检出效果受堆叠层数、材料组合、信噪比、扫描速度共同制约。不同材料、多层堆叠结构对检测方案要求完全不一样，红外和声学各自有适用边界。更小缺陷检测，天然存在灵敏度和量的矛盾。

另一条来自 EBC Financial Group 的报道。文章指出，先进封装已成为半导体产业新的投资热点，其技术涵盖 CoWoS、SoIC 等。目前市场关注的先进封装技术主要包括 CoWoS 2.5D 封装技术、SoIC 3D 芯片堆叠技术、Chiplet、Fan-Out 扇出型封装技术以及 HBM 高带宽内存。先进封装成为市场焦点的原因包括 AI 芯片需求持续增长带动 CoWoS 及相关封装产能需求，以及先进制程微缩难度提高促使通过 Chiplet 及先进封装整合不同芯片。对于投资者而言，观察先进封装概念股时，不应只关注市场题材热度，更需要了解企业在产业链中的实际位置、订单成长、客户认证及营收贡献。

接着看 QQ News 关于先进封装扩产的报道。长电科技、通富微电、华天科技等中国大陆厂商投资总额已超 400 亿元，方向集中在 2.5D/3D 封装、Chiplet 和 HBM。其中长电科技 2026 年投资计划由 110.1 亿元上调至 182 亿元，通富微电 2026 年公司计划投资 91 亿元用于产能建设等，比 2025 年的 60 亿元明显增加，华天南京投资 30 亿元建设先进封测产业基地二期二阶段项目。但受设备交期、材料短缺、人才不足及认证周期限制，产能释放滞后。部分核心先进封测设备交期拉长到 1 年以上，普通设备交期从 3 到 6 个月延长到 6 至 8 个月。全球 95% 以上的 ABF 增层膜由日本味之素供应，今年 8 月味之素通知中国大陆客户削减 30% 的 ABF 膜供货量。全国符合“10 年以上经验加较大算力 AI 或 GPU Chiplet 项目经验”的架构师估计只有 200 到 300 人。单颗 GPU 的测试时间从 Hopper 架构的约 350 秒，拉长到 Blackwell 的 700 至 1000 秒，下一代预计达到 1800 至 2000 秒。测试 socket 的引脚数也从传统手机芯片的约 1500 个激增至 AI 芯片的 6000 个，下一代将突破 10000 个。文章强调，订单不等于收入，送样不等于量产，封测厂扩产也不等于国产份额会同步提升。

另一条来自 TradingView 的消息。苏大维格在先进封装检测领域的布局尚未实现量产收入，目前处于客户测试或样机完成阶段。公司在晶圆级和面板级先进封装光刻领域进行了重点投入与布局，主要布局产品为 W 型 wafer 型和 P 型面板级直写光刻设备。W 型设备正与客户对接测试，P 型样机已完成。公司计划结合维普半导体在检测环节的技术能力，围绕先进封装检测与直写光刻协同布局。

最后一条来自电子工程专辑报道。绍兴光电公共服务平台于 11 月 6 日首次正式对外亮相，全面对外承接硅光芯片测试、TGV 玻璃基板封装等技术服务业务。该中心由柯桥区人民政府与杭州电子科技大学共同支持建设，总投资约 2 亿元，规划建筑面积约 10000 平方米，2026 年 2 月正式投运。平台面向全行业开放共享大型仪器设备和超净间，提供 PIC 高速性能测试、TGV 玻璃基板封装、封装测试表征分析等公共服务。星柯光电产业研究院院长王坤指出，TGV 产业化并非单一环节突破，需上中下游企业协同参与、联合验证以加快从样品验证到批量导入的进程。MathWorks 中国区技术专家陈晓挺分享将 SerDes、信号处理算法、光器件及封装信道纳入联合模型的技术路径，通过结合实测 S 参数与链路模型在硬件定型前评估损耗、串扰、噪声及眼图裕量。
